tasks.short: Monitor infectious disease incidents and report to health agencies.

steps.what: Verify actual infectious disease incidents, case definitions, duplicates and missing clinical facts
inputs: actual laboratory and clinical case records
outputs: verified incident dataset and unresolved exceptions

steps.what: Re-key verified incident fields into the separate agency reporting workspace
inputs: verified incident dataset and unresolved exceptions

steps.what: Prepare agency incident tables and required reporting sections
Check final report, privacy, counts, dates, exceptions and exact agency destination
inputs: verified incident dataset and unresolved exceptions
outputs: final checked incident report and destination

steps.what: Review final incident report and authorise its specified agency submission
inputs: final checked incident report and destination
outputs: independently authorised report version and destination

steps.what: Submit the authorised incident report to the named health agency
inputs: independently authorised report version and destination

tasks.design: First test native incident import and report layouts in the surveillance {DATA_PLATFORM} and {GOV_PORTAL}; bridge only an actual second-system re-key. Stage fields without submission, populate fixed report sections and retain clinical verification, complete final checks, the existing independent reporting review and explicit agency submission.
tasks.previous_blocker: Case fields are entered again in a separate reporting workspace.
tasks.enabler_now: A versioned field mapping can transfer actual verified records without deciding case validity.
tasks.still_hard: Changing case definitions, delayed results and duplicate identities require expert review.
tasks.human_edge: The epidemiologist distinguishes an apparent cluster from reporting artefacts.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate entry; public health decision rights stay the same.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: deterministic mappings can stage verified surveillance fields and fixed report tables; epidemiological case decisions remain human.

assumptions: Provisional workflow with an existing independent public health reporting lead; its four points are excluded, leaving focal baseline96. Do not introduce a new approval job. If the actual reporting route differs, map that route and reweight before estimating.

Actual clinical/laboratory producers supply case id, specimen/result date, disease code, case-definition version, status, geography and provenance through authorised exports. Epidemiologist verifies and resolves absent fields in s1; unsupported interfaces retain manual transfer. No new observation is inferred.

The 25 transfer points represent actual human re-key into a second system, not native import runtime. Eight of25 preparation points are repeated table/heading assembly; seventeen remain for exceptions and narrative. Saves in the same workspace are included unchanged in final preparation. Access basis and minimal fields require local confirmation.
unknowns: Which actual agency permits a staging interface?
research_questions: Can a historical case batch reconcile counts and identifiers without any agency submission?

incremental.description: Maintain agency mappings, case-definition versions and reconciliation exceptions.

approvals.approved_version: s4 final report snapshot and exact agency destination as reviewed in s5; any edit voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes25 second-system entry points plus8 repeated report-assembly points:33/96*100 minus1.5 upkeep=32.875. Low: a changed agency schema leaves15 entry points manual; only10 transfer points and8 fixed reporting points disappear, giving18/96*100 minus1.5=17.25. Clinical checks, lead review and actual send remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan and direct disease, prevention and treatment studies.

steps.what: Choose study questions, disease measures, design, safeguards and analysis strategy
outputs: chosen study design and scientific rationale

steps.what: Prepare study plan, schedule and chosen protocol sections
inputs: chosen study design and scientific rationale

steps.what: Check complete study plan and retain its final internal version
inputs: chosen study design and scientific rationale

steps.what: Direct actual study operations, resolve scientific problems and adjust work
Record actual study decisions and follow-up assignments after direction

tasks.design: Configure reusable study-plan sections and schedule fields in {DOCS}/{PROJECT} after the epidemiologist chooses the design. Keep complete plan checking, study direction and actual post-direction records; ordinary internal saves earn no saving and need no self-approval gate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stable plan sections are repeatedly assembled around new scientific choices.
tasks.enabler_now: Native section reuse avoids some assembly without generating a study design.
tasks.still_hard: Confounding, feasibility, participant protection and study deviations remain scientific decisions.
tasks.human_edge: The epidemiologist changes a feasible-looking design that cannot answer the actual question.
tasks.altitude: Less repetitive planning assembly; study accountability stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native document sections and project schedules can reuse stable study administration content.

assumptions: Provisional shares: seven of25 preparation points are reusable section/schedule assembly, eighteen cover study-specific preparation. Actual direction25 and new decision recording5 are retained separately; save clicks are included unchanged within final checks and records, not an invented approval step.

The epidemiologist supplies actual objectives, population, measures, dates and responsibilities; project owners supply actual progress. Missing facts are obtained from those owners and entered manually. No participant recruitment, ethics submission or other-role effort is attributed to this task boundary; actual separately authorised submissions must be mapped if owned here.
unknowns: Which plan sections are already reused natively?
research_questions: Does section reuse save assembly for observational and intervention studies alike?

incremental.description: Maintain current study-plan sections and schedule field definitions.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes7 repetitive preparation points minus0.7 upkeep=6.3. Low: a novel animal-disease study needs new protocol content, leaving only3 reusable scheduling/administration points minus0.7=2.3. Design, full final checks, direction and actual records keep their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise on protocols, questionnaires, sampling and analysis.

steps.what: Locate relevant protocol versions, questionnaire items and actual study design evidence
inputs: actual study documents and data dictionaries

steps.what: Evaluate protocols, health status questionnaires, sample selection and analysis choices
Discuss recommendations and tradeoffs with the actual study team
Write and check actual written advice and retain the internal consultation record

tasks.design: Configure a versioned source index in {DOCS}/{DATA_PLATFORM} for actual protocols and questionnaires. Save locating effort while retaining scientific evaluation, live consultation and the complete written advice and its ordinary internal save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Protocol and instrument versions can take repeated navigation to locate.
tasks.enabler_now: Native metadata and links can point to current sources without assessing scientific validity.
tasks.still_hard: Sample bias, construct validity and analysis assumptions need expert assessment.
tasks.human_edge: The epidemiologist spots a questionnaire change that destroys comparability.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less source navigation; expertise and decision rights remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a native versioned document index can reduce locating current protocol sources while scientific advice remains human.

assumptions: Provisional locating20 includes five points of repeated version/path navigation; fifteen source-selection and reading points remain. No saving is assigned to conversation or written scientific advice.

Study owners supply document id, version, population, instrument and current status. Conflicting versions are resolved with their owner; absent metadata means manual lookup. Boundary covers internal consultation in a shared workspace; an actual separate delivery must be mapped if present, with its existing authorisation and no assumed saving.
unknowns: How often does the team already link the exact current version?
research_questions: Can an index avoid obsolete questionnaires without hiding valid earlier versions?

incremental.description: Keep protocol and instrument version links current.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes5 version/path navigation points minus0.5 upkeep=4.5. Low: a new study uses an unfamiliar instrument outside the index; only1 known protocol-location point is removed, minus0.5=0.5. Scientific reading, evaluation, discussion and complete written advice remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write epidemiological articles for professional journals.

steps.what: Choose article claims and verify actual study results, limitations and source references
inputs: actual source papers and journal instructions
outputs: chosen claims and verified results/reference packet

steps.what: Assemble article tables, references and required journal sections
inputs: chosen claims and verified results/reference packet
outputs: article skeleton with sourced tables and references

steps.what: Draft article prose explaining actual methods, results and limitations
inputs: article skeleton with sourced tables and references
chosen claims and verified results/reference packet

loop.purpose: Draft faithful prose from selected verified study material
loop.input: chosen claims, verified results and sourced article skeleton
loop.output: complete draft with every factual claim linked to its source
loop.check: Epidemiologist checks causal language, denominators, limitations, omissions and every reference against actual sources
loop.stop: Missing source, conflicting result or two failed revisions returns affected text to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native tables and reference formatting serve s2; variable methods and limitation prose needs semantic drafting and checking

steps.what: Finish and check the complete article and retain its final internal version
inputs: actual study sources and journal instructions
outputs: final checked article package and journal destination

steps.what: Review final article and approve exact journal submission as existing coauthor reviewer
inputs: final checked article package and journal destination
outputs: independently approved article version and journal destination

steps.what: Send the approved final article package to the specified professional journal
inputs: independently approved article version and journal destination

tasks.design: Configure journal structure, table and reference reuse in {DOCS}, then use a bounded prose draft only from the epidemiologist's verified study packet. Preserve complete author checks, the actual independent coauthor review and explicit submission through the journal {PARTNER_PORTAL}; internal saves earn no saving or self-gate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Article tables, references and prose must be rebuilt around each study.
tasks.enabler_now: Native structure plus constrained source-linked drafting can reduce preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Causal interpretation, limitations and publication responsibility stay with researchers.
tasks.human_edge: The epidemiologist removes a plausible sentence that overstates what the design establishes.
tasks.altitude: Less article assembly and first-draft typing; scientific accountability stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a source-constrained draft can assist scientific prose, but methods, meaning and citations require full researcher checks.

assumptions: Provisional multi-author workflow with existing independent coauthor review5, excluded from focal baseline95. No new reviewer is created. Reviewer authorship decisions and actual editor review are not claimed as focal savings.

The study analyst supplies actual table id/version, population, denominator, estimate, uncertainty and method; the epidemiologist verifies these and chooses claims in s1. Missing statistics or sources trigger manual clarification, not invention. Seven of20 assembly points are repeated layout/reference handling; nine of30 prose points are first-draft typing removed after retained review. Existing automation gets no new credit.
unknowns: Does the actual journal permit this drafting assistance and require disclosure?
Which article sections already use native reuse?
research_questions: Can reviewers reconcile every proposed claim and citation to the verified study packet?

incremental.description: Maintain journal layouts and source-linked drafting checks, including actual disclosure requirements.

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact final article package and named journal destination reviewed in s5; any edit voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes7 assembly and9 prose-typing points:16/95*100 minus1.4=15.442. Low: an unusual outbreak analysis needs most prose written afresh; only4 stable layout points and2 descriptive prose points are removed, giving6/95*100 minus1.4=4.916. Complete scientific checks, coauthor review and submission keep their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce repeated report entry and writing preparation while retaining epidemiological decisions.
role.ambitious_version: More reliable preparation of existing reports and articles, with unchanged scientific and release authority.
